lessons.title: Manufacturing & Production
lessons.description: Vocabulary for factory processes, equipment, output, and product quality.
lessons.tip: Distinguish a flaw in a product from downtime in a production process.

words.meaning: A sequence of workstations where a product is assembled.
words.example: The assembly line now installs each control panel in less than four minutes.

words.meaning: A quantity of goods produced together in one run.
words.example: One batch was held back after the labels showed an outdated model number.

words.meaning: The maximum amount a facility can produce or hold.
words.example: The plant expects to reach full capacity before the seasonal order rush.

words.meaning: One part of a larger product or machine.
words.example: A supplier notified us that a component for the display unit was delayed.

words.meaning: A flaw that makes a product imperfect or unusable.
words.example: Inspectors found a defect in the casing before the units were packed.

words.meaning: A period when a machine or operation is not working.
words.example: Replacing the worn belt during lunch kept equipment downtime brief.

words.meaning: The ability to produce results with little wasted time or material.
words.example: The new floor layout improved efficiency without adding another shift.

words.meaning: Special tools used to manufacture or shape a product.
words.vietnameseMeaning: dụng cụ chuyên dùng trong sản xuất
words.example: The supplier needs two weeks to prepare tooling for the new bottle shape.
words.tip: In manufacturing, tooling refers to specialized production tools rather than general equipment.

words.meaning: The process of making a product or structure from materials.
words.example: Metal fabrication for the support frames will start on Monday.

words.meaning: A building where goods are made, assembled, or processed.
words.example: All visitors must collect a badge at the factory entrance.

words.meaning: A careful examination to check quality or condition.
words.example: A final inspection is required before each pump can be shipped.

words.meaning: The process of counting and checking the goods or materials held in stock.
words.vietnameseMeaning: việc kiểm kê hàng tồn kho
words.example: Quarterly stocktaking will begin after the last production run on Friday.
words.tip: Stocktaking is the process; stocktake is also used as a noun or verb, especially in British English.

words.meaning: Machines used for a particular industrial purpose.
words.example: The machinery in the east wing will be replaced over the summer.

words.meaning: To make goods, especially in large quantities using machinery.
words.example: The company manufactures replacement valves at its Ohio plant.

words.meaning: A person who runs or controls a machine or process.
words.example: Each machine operator completed the updated safety course.

words.meaning: The amount of goods produced by a person, machine, or facility.
words.example: The second shift increased daily output by twelve percent.

words.meaning: Materials or methods used to wrap and protect a product.
words.example: The revised packaging includes clearer recycling instructions.

words.meaning: An industrial facility where products are manufactured.
words.example: The plant will close for two days while its power system is upgraded.

words.meaning: The process or activity of making goods.
words.example: Production paused until the replacement parts arrived from the supplier.

words.meaning: An early model built to test a design before full production.
words.example: Engineers tested a prototype of the lighter pump housing.

words.meaning: The procedures used to ensure products meet required standards.
words.example: Quality control rejected the lot after two measurements fell outside tolerance.

words.meaning: A basic substance used to manufacture a product.
words.example: The mill stores raw material near the cutting area to speed up processing.

words.meaning: A scheduled period of work for a group of employees.
words.example: The night shift will take over once the calibration is complete.

words.meaning: A worker who directs a crew, especially on a factory floor or construction site.
words.vietnameseMeaning: người giám sát đội làm việc
words.example: The foreperson reassigned two technicians when the packaging station fell behind.
words.tip: Foreperson is a gender-neutral term for the person leading a work crew.

words.meaning: An amount of materials available for use.
words.example: The plant keeps an emergency supply of protective gloves in the tool room.

words.meaning: A skilled worker who installs, maintains, or repairs technical equipment.
words.example: A technician traced the vibration to a loose motor mount.

words.meaning: The amount of usable product obtained from a process.
words.example: Careful cutting raised the yield from each sheet of steel.

words.meaning: The adjustment of an instrument to ensure accurate measurements.
words.example: Calibration records must be updated after the pressure gauge is serviced.

words.meaning: Work done to keep equipment in good operating condition.
words.example: Routine maintenance kept the conveyor belt running through the rush order.

words.meaning: A detailed description of required features or standards.
words.example: The finished casing must meet the client's material specifications.

lessons.title: Shipping & Logistics
lessons.description: Vocabulary for packing, transporting, clearing, and delivering goods.
lessons.tip: Check whether a shipping notice gives a dispatch date, arrival date, or delivery deadline.

words.meaning: A document recording the terms and details of air-freight transport.
words.example: The broker requested a copy of the airway bill before releasing the cargo.

words.meaning: Goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.
words.example: The cargo was transferred to a refrigerated truck at the airport.

words.meaning: A company that transports goods or passengers.
words.example: The carrier will collect the cartons from the loading dock at noon.

words.meaning: A shipment of goods sent to someone or somewhere.
words.example: The consignment arrived with all six crates accounted for.

words.meaning: The government agency that checks goods entering or leaving a country.
words.example: Customs held the shipment until the missing certificate was submitted.

words.meaning: The act or process of taking goods to a recipient.
words.example: The customer requested delivery before the store opens on Monday.

words.meaning: To send goods or a vehicle to a destination.
words.example: The warehouse will dispatch the replacement parts this afternoon.

words.meaning: The process of supplying goods to locations or customers.
words.example: Regional distribution is managed from the new facility in Reno.

words.meaning: Goods transported in bulk, or the charge for transporting them.
words.vietnameseMeaning: h?ng h?a v?n chuy?n; c??c v?n t?i
words.example: Freight costs rose after the route was changed to air transport.

words.meaning: The process of moving, storing, or treating goods.
words.example: Fragile items require careful handling throughout the journey.

words.meaning: A charge for keeping a shipping container or vessel beyond the allowed time.
words.example: The consignee arranged collection quickly to avoid another day of demurrage.
words.tip: Demurrage is a delay-related shipping charge, not the general freight cost.

words.meaning: A document listing the goods carried on a vehicle or vessel.
words.example: The driver checked each crate against the cargo manifest.

words.meaning: A request to supply goods or services.
words.example: The buyer split the order into two deliveries to meet storage limits.

words.meaning: A wrapped parcel prepared for transport or delivery.
words.example: One package was returned because the suite number was missing.

words.meaning: A flat platform used to stack and move goods.
words.example: Workers secured the boxes to a pallet before loading the truck.

words.meaning: A place where ships load and unload goods.
words.example: The vessel is expected to reach the port early Thursday.

words.meaning: A quantity of goods sent together to a destination.
words.example: The shipment includes spare filters for all three service centers.

words.meaning: A person or business that sends goods.
words.example: The shipper must provide the correct export classification.

words.meaning: The person or organization that receives something.
words.example: The recipient signed for the parcel at the reception desk.

words.meaning: A way or path used to transport goods or travel.
words.example: The carrier selected a shorter route to avoid the mountain pass.

words.meaning: A document listing the contents of a shipment and how they are packed.
words.example: The receiver used the packing list to confirm the number of cartons in the delivery.
words.tip: A packing list describes shipment contents; an invoice states charges.

words.meaning: The act or space of keeping goods until they are needed.
words.example: Cold storage is available for temperature-sensitive products.

words.meaning: The process of following a shipment's progress.
words.example: Online tracking shows that the parcel has left the sorting center.

words.meaning: The transfer of cargo from one vessel or transport route to another during a journey.
words.example: Because the direct sailing was full, the container will undergo transshipment in Busan.
words.tip: Transshipment adds an intermediate transfer point to a cargo route.

words.meaning: A large building used to store goods before distribution.
words.example: The warehouse added shelving to make room for seasonal stock.

words.meaning: A transport document acknowledging receipt of goods and stating carriage terms.
words.example: The bank asked the exporter to submit the original bill of lading.

words.meaning: An official statement describing goods being imported or exported for customs authorities.
words.example: The broker corrected the customs declaration to include the replacement parts.
words.tip: A customs declaration provides shipment details to customs; clearance is the approval to proceed.

words.meaning: The planning and coordination of moving and storing goods.
words.example: The logistics team arranged separate vehicles for the two delivery zones.

words.meaning: A large standardized box used to transport goods.
words.example: The sealed container was loaded onto the vessel at Pier 4.

words.meaning: A tax charged on goods imported into or exported from a country.
words.example: The buyer checked the tariff before approving the import budget.

lessons.title: Contracts & Agreements
lessons.description: Vocabulary for negotiated commitments, legal terms, and changes to agreements.
lessons.tip: Look for the clause or condition that explains when a commitment applies.

words.meaning: A negotiated arrangement accepted by two or more parties.
words.example: Both firms signed an agreement to share the research costs.

words.meaning: To make a formal change to a document or agreement.
words.example: The supplier asked to amend the delivery clause before signing.

words.meaning: A separate section of a legal document that states a rule or condition.
words.example: A confidentiality clause protects the client's technical drawings.

words.meaning: A promise or obligation to do something.
words.example: The retailer made a six-month commitment to purchase the product.

words.meaning: To act according to a rule, law, or agreement.
words.example: All vendors must comply with the revised safety requirements.

words.meaning: A requirement or circumstance that affects an agreement.
words.example: Payment is due within ten days if this condition is met.

words.meaning: The duty to keep information private.
words.example: The confidentiality agreement covers customer records and pricing data.

words.meaning: Permission or agreement given voluntarily.
words.example: The company obtained written consent before using the client's logo.

words.meaning: A legally binding agreement between parties.
words.example: The maintenance contract expires at the end of September.

words.meaning: A person or thing with the same role on the other side of an arrangement.
words.example: Our legal team sent the revised draft to its counterpart in Singapore.

words.meaning: The latest time or date by which something must be completed.
words.example: The bid deadline was moved to Friday at 3 p.m.

words.meaning: A disagreement that may require formal resolution.
words.example: The two companies settled the invoice dispute without going to court.

words.meaning: The length of time that something continues.
words.example: The agreement has a duration of three years, with an annual review.

words.meaning: To make sure a rule or agreement is obeyed.
words.example: The court may enforce the payment terms if negotiations fail.

words.meaning: An additional period of time or an increase in length.
words.example: The client approved a two-week extension for the installation work.

words.meaning: To state a specific requirement or condition as part of an agreement.
words.vietnameseMeaning: quy định rõ; nêu điều kiện
words.example: The service contract stipulates that emergency calls receive a response within two hours.
words.tip: Stipulate is often followed by that or for when stating a contract requirement.

words.meaning: A duty or commitment that a person or organization must fulfill.
words.example: The lease places an obligation on the tenant to insure the equipment.

words.meaning: A person or organization involved in a contract or legal matter.
words.example: Each party will receive a signed copy of the final document.

words.meaning: A punishment or fee for breaking a rule or agreement.
words.example: A late-payment penalty applies to balances unpaid after 30 days.

words.meaning: A specific term or requirement included in a legal document.
words.example: One provision lets either side cancel with 60 days' notice.

words.meaning: To extend the period for which an agreement remains in effect.
words.example: The firm plans to renew its cleaning contract for another year.

words.meaning: To formally cancel a contract or decision, often restoring the parties to their earlier position.
words.vietnameseMeaning: hủy bỏ hợp đồng; bãi bỏ
words.example: The buyer may rescind the purchase agreement if the required inspection is not completed.
words.tip: Rescind is a formal legal verb; rescission is the noun form.

words.meaning: The conditions or rules that form an agreement.
words.example: Please review the payment terms before approving the purchase.

words.meaning: Legally or officially acceptable and in effect.
words.example: The offer remains valid until the close of business on June 30.

words.meaning: An act of failing to follow a law or agreement.
words.example: Sharing the files externally would constitute a breach of the agreement.

words.meaning: A contractual promise to compensate someone for specified loss or legal liability.
words.example: The vendor accepted an indemnity for losses caused by its installation work.
words.tip: An indemnity allocates responsibility for particular losses; its scope depends on the contract.

words.meaning: A legal restriction or undertaking not to reveal private or protected information.
words.vietnameseMeaning: việc không tiết lộ thông tin
words.example: The non-disclosure provision remains in effect after the consulting contract ends.
words.tip: Non-disclosure commonly appears in non-disclosure agreement (NDA).

words.meaning: Legal responsibility for a loss, injury, or debt.
words.example: The agreement limits the vendor's liability for indirect damages.

words.meaning: A person's written name used to confirm or authorize a document.
words.example: The purchase order is ready but needs the director's signature.

words.meaning: A statement of fact made by one party that another party may rely on when entering an agreement.
words.vietnameseMeaning: tuyên bố về sự thật trong hợp đồng
words.example: A statement by the seller about the equipment age was included in the final agreement.
words.tip: In contract language, a representation is a factual statement, not simply a company representative.

lessons.title: Company Management
lessons.description: Vocabulary for leadership, staffing, organizational structure, and strategy.
lessons.tip: Management terms may describe a person's authority or a planned company action; use context to tell which.

words.meaning: To manage or organize the operation of an organization or program.
words.example: The regional office administers employee benefits for four branches.

words.meaning: The act of supervising an activity or ensuring it is properly managed.
words.example: Senior management provides oversight of the branch expansion plan.
words.tip: Oversight can mean supervision; in other contexts it can mean an accidental omission.

words.meaning: To give someone a task, duty, or position.
words.example: The team lead assigned the market analysis to two new analysts.

words.meaning: The power or right to make decisions or give instructions.
words.example: Branch managers have authority to approve routine expenses.

words.meaning: A group elected or appointed to oversee an organization.
words.example: The board will review the expansion proposal at its quarterly meeting.

words.meaning: The highest-ranking manager responsible for leading a company.
words.example: The chief executive outlined the firm's priorities for the coming year.

words.meaning: To work jointly with others on a task or project.
words.example: Finance and marketing will collaborate on the new pricing plan.

words.meaning: The process of providing an organization or team with enough employees.
words.example: Staffing for the new customer-support unit will be finalized by the end of the month.
words.tip: Staffing focuses on employee numbers and assignment, rather than a company department.

words.meaning: A senior manager who helps direct an organization.
words.vietnameseMeaning: gi?m ??c; nh? qu?n l? c?p cao
words.example: A senior executive will present the quarterly results to investors.

words.meaning: A system in which people or groups are ranked by authority.
words.example: The updated hierarchy clarifies who approves regional budgets.

words.meaning: A new plan or action intended to achieve a goal.
words.example: The company launched an initiative to reduce unnecessary travel.

words.meaning: The ability or position to guide and direct people.
words.example: Effective leadership helped the division recover after a difficult year.

words.meaning: A person responsible for directing a team or business activity.
words.example: The hiring manager will meet the finalists on Thursday.

words.meaning: The joining of two companies to form one organization.
words.example: The merger will combine the firms' customer-support operations.

words.meaning: A goal that a person or organization plans to achieve.
words.example: Each department submitted a measurable objective for the next quarter.

words.meaning: To supervise or be responsible for an activity or group.
words.example: A compliance officer will oversee the annual policy review.

words.meaning: To introduce a new employee to an organization, its work, and its procedures.
words.vietnameseMeaning: hướng dẫn nhân viên mới hòa nhập
words.example: Human resources will onboard the analysts before they join their project teams.
words.tip: Onboard is a verb used for welcoming and preparing a new employee.

words.meaning: A general instruction that helps employees make decisions or perform a task.
words.vietnameseMeaning: hướng dẫn; nguyên tắc chỉ đạo
words.example: The expense guideline explains which costs require approval from managers.
words.tip: A guideline offers direction and may be less strict than a formal policy or rule.

words.meaning: Guidance and support provided by a more experienced person to a colleague.
words.example: The company mentorship program pairs new managers with experienced department leaders.
words.tip: Mentorship describes a developmental relationship, not an employee change in rank.

words.meaning: The process of preparing for the transfer of leadership or key responsibilities.
words.example: The board began succession planning for the planned retirement of its chief operating officer.
words.tip: Succession planning identifies and prepares people to take over important roles.

words.meaning: To organize a company or department in a different way.
words.example: Executives plan to restructure the support team around product lines.

words.meaning: The degree to which a company or activity generates profit after costs.
words.example: Management reviewed the profitability of each service line before renewing supplier agreements.
words.tip: Profitability concerns profit relative to costs; revenue is income from sales before expenses.

words.meaning: A person or organization that owns shares in a company.
words.example: Shareholders will vote on the proposed board appointments next week.

words.meaning: A plan designed to achieve a long-term goal.
words.example: The new strategy focuses on retaining existing business customers.

words.meaning: An employee who has a lower rank than another person.
words.example: Supervisors should give subordinates clear feedback after reviews.

words.meaning: To direct and monitor the work of a person or group.
words.example: She supervises a team that handles corporate accounts.

words.meaning: The combined effort of people working toward a shared goal.
words.example: Good teamwork helped the launch team resolve supply issues quickly.

words.meaning: The rate at which employees leave and are replaced, or the value of sales.
words.vietnameseMeaning: t? l? ngh? vi?c; doanh thu
words.example: Staff turnover fell after the company expanded its training program.

words.meaning: The total group of people employed by an organization or industry.
words.example: The company offered digital training to its entire workforce.

words.meaning: The act of assigning tasks or authority to another person.
words.example: Delegation allowed the department head to focus on the merger review.

lessons.title: Real Estate & Construction
lessons.description: Vocabulary for property, leases, building work, and construction projects.
lessons.tip: Construction notices distinguish an estimate from a permit, and a tenant from a landlord.

words.meaning: A professional who designs buildings and prepares construction plans.
words.example: The architect revised the lobby plans to improve wheelchair access.

words.meaning: A detailed plan or technical drawing for a building or project.
words.example: The contractor compared the electrical work with the latest blueprint.

words.meaning: A structure with walls and a roof, used for a particular purpose.
words.example: The office building will remain open during the lobby renovation.

words.meaning: A person or company hired to perform construction or other work.
words.example: The contractor expects to finish the parking-area repairs by Friday.

words.meaning: The process of building or assembling a structure.
words.example: Construction on the east entrance is scheduled to begin in May.

words.meaning: The process of building or improving property, or the resulting project.
words.vietnameseMeaning: d? ?n ph?t tri?n; s? ph?t tri?n
words.example: The development will include two office blocks and a public courtyard.

words.meaning: A calculated judgment of the likely cost, size, or time needed.
words.example: The builder provided a cost estimate before ordering the stone.

words.meaning: A legal right to use part of land owned by someone else for a specific purpose.
words.vietnameseMeaning: quyền sử dụng hạn chế đối với đất của người khác
words.example: The utility company holds an easement allowing access to the underground power lines.
words.tip: An easement grants a limited land-use right and does not usually transfer ownership.

words.meaning: The solid base on which a building is constructed.
words.example: The inspection confirmed that the foundation had cured properly.

words.meaning: A legal agreement that allows someone to use property for a period of time.
words.example: The office lease includes access to two meeting rooms.

words.meaning: A person or company that rents property to someone else.
words.example: The landlord arranged for the heating system to be inspected.

words.meaning: A measured area of land, often intended for construction.
words.example: The developer purchased the corner lot for a small retail center.

words.meaning: A professional who estimates the value of property or other assets.
words.example: The lender sent an appraiser to assess the office building before approving the loan.
words.tip: An appraiser estimates property value; an occupancy certificate concerns permission to use a building.

words.meaning: The process of repairing or improving an existing building.
words.example: The renovation will update the restrooms without closing the entire office.

words.meaning: A person or organization that rents and occupies property.
words.example: Each tenant received notice about the elevator upgrade.

words.meaning: The regulation of how land and buildings may be used in different areas.
words.example: Zoning rules limit the height of buildings on this street.

words.meaning: Related to factories, manufacturing, or other large-scale production.
words.example: The industrial property includes a loading bay and space for heavy machinery.
words.tip: Industrial property is generally used for manufacturing or warehousing, unlike retail space.

words.meaning: The act of pulling down or destroying a building.
words.example: Demolition of the unused annex will start after utility lines are disconnected.

words.meaning: An official document that gives permission to do something.
words.example: The crew cannot begin excavation until the permit is posted.

words.meaning: A building and the land around it, especially as a business location.
words.example: Smoking is prohibited anywhere on the premises.

words.meaning: A building or land owned or rented by a person or company.
words.example: The company is considering property near the new transit station.

words.meaning: Land and buildings, especially considered as property for sale or rent.
words.example: The firm specializes in real estate for small technology companies.

words.meaning: Designed or used as a place for people to live.
words.example: The residential units will be built behind the retail space.

words.meaning: A particular place where a building or activity is located.
words.example: Visitors must wear hard hats while walking through the construction site.

words.meaning: Related to the framework or supporting parts of a building.
words.example: An engineer found no structural damage after the minor earthquake.

words.meaning: The required distance between a building and a property boundary or road.
words.example: The architect moved the entrance to comply with the required street setback.
words.tip: Building setbacks are commonly specified in local zoning and planning rules.

words.meaning: A service such as water, gas, or electricity supplied to a building.
words.example: Utility work will temporarily interrupt water service on the lower floor.

words.meaning: Not occupied or in use.
words.example: The vacant office next to reception is available for a short-term lease.

words.meaning: The movement of fresh air through a room or building.
words.example: Improved ventilation will make the conference room more comfortable.

words.meaning: The process of removing earth to prepare a foundation or site.
words.example: Excavation exposed an old water pipe that was not on the original plans.
